metadata.title: ऐसी मछली पहली बार खाई | Napham – A Unique Fish Dish | Food of Northeast
metadata.description:
Napham is one of the most popular and flavourful dishes from Bodoland, celebrated for its simplicity and unique taste. Made with fermented fish, fresh herbs, and local spices, Napham embodies the deep connection of the Bodo people with their land and rivers. This traditional delicacy, now honored with a Geographical Indication (GI) tag, is both easy and quick to prepare — a true reflection of Bodo culinary wisdom.

In this special episode of Tribal Kitchen, we bring you the authentic taste of Napham, exploring how this humble yet iconic dish continues to preserve the cultural identity and traditional food practices of the Bodo community.
